avis.titre: Excellent for Mature SkinExcellent for Mature Skin
avis.texte: In my opinion, Lierac is one of the most underrated skincare companies out there. They consistently make well-formulated products that don’t always get the attention they deserve, especially here in the U.S. If you know French pharmacy skincare, you already understand that some of the best products are often the quiet performers rather than the loudest marketed ones. This eye cream is a perfect example. At 52, post-menopausal, with dry, mature skin, the eye area is one of my biggest priorities. It tends to show fatigue, dryness, fine lines, and loss of firmness faster than anywhere else. I purchased this specifically to use alongside Lierac’s menopause day cream, night cream, and sunscreen that I’m currently using, and it fits beautifully into that routine. The first thing I noticed was the texture. It feels rich enough to be nourishing, but not heavy or greasy. That balance matters because many eye creams are either too light to do much or so thick they become difficult to wear during the day. This one feels comfortable, smooth, and absorbs nicely while still giving the under-eye area the moisture it needs. What I appreciate most is how it makes the eye area look more rested, smoother, and better cared for. Fine lines caused by dryness look softer, concealer applies better over it, and the skin feels more supple over time. I also think this formula is especially well suited for mature skin.
